_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for trail/area data provenance + licensing. The build MUST fail closed: any feature whose source has commercial_ok=false OR redistribute_ok=false must never be written to dist/ tiles. Every field marked verify_before_build=true must be re-confirmed against the live source before that source's data ships.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap (Geofabrik extracts / planet)

access.runtime_api_forbidden: Do NOT call Overpass at app runtime; build-time only.

sources.notes: Backbone for trails AND areas worldwide. Rendered tiles are a Produced Work (attribution only). A distributed derivative DATABASE triggers ODbL share-alike.

sources.name: Overture Maps base theme (protected subtype)

access.tool: overturemaps CLI or DuckDB over S3

sources.notes: VERIFY exact `class` strings for {national_park,state_park,forest,wilderness_area,nature_reserve} against live schema before coding against them.

sources.name: USGS Protected Areas Database of the US (PAD-US)
sources.notes: Do not compare versions to infer real-world change. Carries WDPA ID for cross-referencing (do not ship WDPA geometry).

sources.name: USFS National Forest System Trails + boundaries
sources.notes: Known contradictory access/date fields, abbreviated names, over-dense geometry. Distinguish proclaimed boundary vs surface-ownership parcels for fog-of-war fill.

sources.name: NPS unit boundaries + trails (IRMA / NPS Open Data)
sources.notes: Publishes ONLY officially maintained trails, no difficulty ratings. Use as official-trail whitelist inside park boundaries. NPS asked OSM not to bulk-import.

sources.name: Parks Canada Trails APCA
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada (Parks Canada)
sources.notes: Explicitly 'not necessarily complete'. National parks/historic sites/marine conservation areas only.

sources.name: BC Recreation Sites & Trails / BC Data Catalogue
sources.license: VERIFY (Open Government Licence – British Columbia, per-layer)
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – British Columbia
sources.notes: Confirm per-layer license before ship. commercial_ok/redistribute_ok null => build must treat as fail-closed until set true.

sources.name: EEA Nationally designated areas (CDDA)

attribution_overrides.EE: Estonian Environmental Register 18.02.2013. On-line resource linkage: www.keskkonnainfo.ee

sources.notes: EEA lacks permission to redistribute sites reported by EE/IE/TR — for those countries fall back to national portal or OSM. Apply per-country attribution overrides when those countries are in-tile.

sources.name: swisstopo swissTLM3D hiking trails (Wanderwege)
sources.notes: Attribution required. Accuracy 1-3 m for poorly-defined features. Gold-standard national trail layer.

sources.name: IGN BD TOPO / BD Forêt (France)
sources.provider: Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière (IGN)
sources.notes: Open since 2021-01-01. Raw path (sentier) geometry is open; be mindful of FFRandonnée GR branding sensitivities (branding, not geometry).

sources.name: Bundesamt für Naturschutz Schutzgebiete (Germany)
sources.notes: Open-data availability varies by Land. CDDA is the cleaner pan-Germany boundary fallback. Null flags => fail-closed until confirmed.

sources.name: basemap.at (Austria)
sources.notes: Open Government Data Austria.

sources.name: Kartverket turrutebasen (Norway hiking trails)
sources.notes: Confirm license per product on Geonorge.

sources.name: Lantmäteriet open data (Sweden)
sources.notes: CC0 — no restrictions even commercial.

sources.name: National Land Survey Maastotietokanta / Metsähallitus (Finland)
sources.notes: Null flags => fail-closed until confirmed.

sources.name: Ordnance Survey OpenData (Great Britain)
sources.attribution: Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right [year]
sources.notes: PRoW (Public Rights of Way) NOT in open data — use OSM for the walking network. OS supplies boundaries/basemap. Insert build year into attribution.

sources.name: Tailte Éireann / OSNI (Ireland / Northern Ireland)
sources.provider: Tailte Éireann / Ordnance Survey Northern Ireland
sources.notes: CDDA excludes IE, so no EEA fallback for Irish boundaries — use national portal or OSM. Null flags => fail-closed.

sources.name: NZ Department of Conservation — Public Conservation Land + tracks
sources.attribution: Sourced from the NZ Department of Conservation (CC BY 4.0)
sources.notes: Tracks originally CC-BY-3.0. Best-provisioned country for this use case — recommended pilot.

sources.name: LINZ Data Service (New Zealand)
sources.provider: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand
sources.attribution: Sourced from the LINZ Data Service and licensed for reuse under CC BY 4.0
sources.notes: Explicitly commercial-friendly. 'Almost all' LINZ layers are CC-BY-4.0 — confirm the specific layer.

sources.name: NSW NPWS walking tracks + park boundaries
sources.attribution: © State Government of NSW and its agencies (CC BY 4.0)
sources.notes: Track layer includes non-public features (fire trails, continuity lines, footpaths) — filter before ship.

sources.name: WA DBCA Legislated Lands + Long Trails
sources.provider: WA Dept of Biodiversity, Conservation & Attractions
sources.notes: Includes Bibbulmun Track, Cape to Cape.

sources.name: Collaborative Australian Protected Areas Database (CAPAD)
sources.notes: National protected-area overlay for AU.

sources.name: Chile IDE MBN / CONAF SIT / MMA protected areas
sources.provider: Ministerio de Bienes Nacionales / CONAF / MMA (Chile)
sources.license: attribution-request (no explicit non-commercial clause found — VERIFY per-ficha)
sources.attribution: Fuente: Ministerio de Bienes Nacionales / CONAF, Chile
sources.latest_version: VERIFY (May 2026 revision updated Lauca, Radal Siete Tazas, Villarrica)
sources.notes: Data labeled 'referential' — mark referential=true on polygons; never present as legally precise. Null flags => fail-closed until per-ficha terms confirmed.

sources.name: Argentina APN Áreas Protegidas Nacionales
sources.attribution: Fuente: Administración de Parques Nacionales, Argentina
sources.notes: Boundaries 'meramente ilustrativo … no mensuras definitivas' — mark referential=true. Null flags => fail-closed until confirmed.

sources.name: Peru SERNANP GEO ANP (protected areas cadastre)
sources.license: public-domain-NON-commercial (comercialización por terceros con fines lucrativos PROHIBIDA)
sources.notes: ⚠️ DO NOT SHIP. commercial_ok=false forces fail-closed. Use ONLY as an internal validation/reference layer, never redistribute the polygons. Seek written SERNANP authorization to change this.

sources.name: SANParks Data Repository (South Africa)
sources.license: mixed (some open, some require registration + data-use agreement) — VERIFY per-layer
sources.notes: Boundaries generally public; sensitive/management layers gated behind DUA. Null flags => fail-closed until per-layer confirmed.

prohibited_sources.name: WDPA / WDPCA / Protected Planet
prohibited_sources.reason: No commercial use without written UNEP-WCMC permission; forbids redistribution through interactive web maps / mobile apps. NEVER ship. Use only WDPA IDs (as cross-ref keys) obtained via PAD-US/CDDA, not WDPA geometry.

prohibited_sources.name: AllTrails
prohibited_sources.reason: No public API; ToS forbids scraping; DataDome bot protection.

prohibited_sources.name: Trailforks
prohibited_sources.reason: Partner-gated API; share-alike + must-remain-free policy incompatible with a paid app.

prohibited_sources.name: Strava
prohibited_sources.reason: API forbids showing one user's data to other users; forbids AI use.

prohibited_sources.name: YAMAP / Yamareco (Japan)
prohibited_sources.reason: Proprietary; GPX gated behind paid membership.
